label: Likely scam
advice: Don't reply, click links or call numbers in the message.

reasons: call_forwarding
Asks you to dial a call-forwarding code
Codes like *401*, **21* or *21* forward all your calls to another number. The scammer then receives your bank's OTP calls and chat-app verification calls. Never dial a code someone sends you.
call_back_number

input: This is TRAI. Your number will be disconnected in 2 hours. Press 9 to talk to officer
label: Likely scam
advice: Don't reply, click links or call numbers in the message.
There is no such thing as a "digital arrest". Disconnect and tell a family member.
Lost money? Call 1930 (India's cyber-crime helpline) as fast as possible. Quick reports can freeze the stolen money.
Report it at cybercrime.gov.in, and report fraud calls or SMS on the Chakshu page of sancharsaathi.gov.in.
reasons: authority_threat
Threatens police, CBI, customs, court or "digital arrest"
Police and investigating agencies never arrest anyone over a phone or video call and never ask for money to "clear" a case. "Digital arrest" is not a real legal process.
telecom_disconnect
Claims TRAI or the telecom department will cut your number
TRAI and the telecom department never call or message to disconnect your number. This is often the first step of the "digital arrest" scam.
press_key
Recorded message asking you to "press 9"
Automated calls that say "press 9 to speak to an officer" connect you to a scammer.
authority_mention
Claims to be from police, CBI, customs or another agency
Scammers pose as officials to frighten you. Real agencies send written notices and never ask for money or OTPs over the phone or chat.
